title: Cap. IX Arg. 3 Sol: Docete omnes gentes / Predicate omni creaturae — apostolic authority for the whole world; wall between Jew and Gentile down
pass_a_gloss: From those mandates of Christ, Teach all nations, Preach to every creature, it is rightly gathered that Apostolic authority was committed unto those Disciples, that is, authority not affixed unto any particular Church or nation, but looking unto the whole orb of the lands. It is also rightly inferred that that partition-wall which divided the Gentiles from the Church of God was thrown down, and that the Gospel ought to be preached not unto one nation of the Jews alone, but unto Jews and Gentiles, Greeks and barbarians, wise and unwise, as Paul speaks Rom. i.
pass_b_english: From Christ's charges Teach all nations and Preach to every creature it rightly follows that those disciples were given apostolic authority — not pinned to one church or nation, but aimed at the whole world. It also follows that the wall which shut Gentiles from God's church was broken down, and that the Gospel was to be preached not to Jews alone but to Jews and Gentiles, Greeks and barbarians, wise and unwise — as Paul says in Rom. 1.
source_text: Ex illis mandatis Christi Docete omnes gentes, Predicate omni creaturae, recte colligitur, Discipulis illis auctoritatem Apostolicam, id est, non particulari alicui Ecclesiae aut nationi affixam, sed ad totum terrarum orbem spectantem, fuisse demandatam. Recte etiam infertur, Maceriam illam, quae Gentes ab Ecclesia Dei disterminavit, dirutam fuisse, et debuisse Evangelium, non uni nationi Judaeorum, sed Judaeis et Gentibus, Graecis et barbaris, sapientibus et insipientibus, praedicari, ut loquitur Paulus Rom. i.
